verdict.rationale: Zep's pricing page lists a "Deploy anywhere" option covering Cloud or "Your VPC". Running Zep in your own VPC would let a customer control where their data lives, but this is a single thin marketing mention with no detail on how it works. missing for 10: documented region selection for Zep Cloud, explicit data-residency commitments (e.g. EU/US regions), VPC deployment documentation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
